::: {#def-quartiles}
#### Quartiles

The **first quartile** $Q_1$ and the **third quartile** $Q_3$
are the sample 0.25 and 0.75 quantiles
([sample quantile](nonparametric-models.qmd#def-sample-quantile)),
also called the 25th and 75th percentiles.
The median is the second quartile.
:::

::: notes
Software packages compute quartiles
with different quantile definitions,
so they can disagree slightly for the same data
([quantile conventions](nonparametric-models.qmd#exm-sample-quantile)).
:::
